paragraphs.text: 1. TURN hither, Agni, speak to us: come to us with a gracious mind.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ्नः सुमना भव ।
paragraphs.translit: agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅnaḥ sumanā bhava |

paragraphs.text: Enrich us, Master of the house: thou art the Giver of our wealth.
paragraphs.original: प्र नो यच्छ विशस्पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम्
paragraphs.translit: pra no yaccha viśaspate dhanadā asi nastvam

paragraphs.text: 2. Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Bhaga, and Brhaspati.
paragraphs.original: प्र नो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra no yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let the Gods give their gifts, and let Sunrta, Goddess, grant us wealth.
paragraphs.original: प्र देवाः प्रोत सूनृता रायो देवी ददातु नः
paragraphs.translit: pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. We call King Soma to our aid, and Agni with our songs and hymns,
Adityas, Visnu, Surya, and the Brahman Priest Brhaspati.
4. Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Gods swift to listen, we invoke,
That in the synod all the folk may be benevolent to us.
paragraphs.original: यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असत्
paragraphs.translit: yathā naḥ sarva ijjanaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asat

paragraphs.text: 5. Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Brhaspati,
Vata, Visnu, Sarasvati and the Strong Courser Savitar.
paragraphs.original: वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम्
paragraphs.translit: vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam

paragraphs.text: 6. Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifice:
paragraphs.original: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya |

paragraphs.text: Urge givers to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya
